facts.capacitive_load_guidance: Directly drives up to 1 nF of pure capacitive load in unity gain; some ringing can occur even with capacitive loads below 100 pF in unity-gain configurations with no or very light dc loads, where an RC snubber (619 ohm, 320 pF shown) or a 10-20 ohm series RISO is recommended; overshoot versus capacitive load is given only as typical curves (Figures 20 and 21).

assumed.aggressor: retained ANALOGUE aggressor, 20 V at 20 V/us (OPA4196 slews 7.5/5.5 V/us typ)
